subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose Slack/Discord workspace and server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and which default-off gates, scopes, and requester authorization should be required?
rationale: The code shape is clear enough to implement, but the unresolved decision is whether agent-triggered channel creation belongs behind existing `message.action` write authority or a stronger provider/admin boundary.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Add provider-owned Slack and Discord channel creation behind explicit admin/channel action gates, documented scopes, and focused tests; this resolves the issue while keeping authority local to each plugin.

options.title: Ship only the Discord CLI subset
options.body: Land or replace PR #65065 for Discord CLI wiring while leaving Slack and the broader cross-provider channel-creation feature open for a later decision.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep channel creation outside OpenClaw core/plugin surfaces and recommend external Slack/Discord scripts until there is stronger product/security agreement.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Add provider-owned Slack and Discord channel creation behind explicit admin/channel action gates, documented scopes, and focused tests; this resolves the issue while keeping authority local to each plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: They already provided the detailed prior review and have recent history on the message CLI/docs surface that must coordinate with provider-owned changes.
